reviews.shade: Anua Peach Niacin Spread Cleansing Foam 150ml
reviews.text: Foams so easily even with damp hands this started foaming loads. smells delicious without being overpowering. Left my skin feeling clean but not stripped. Non irritating on my skin even around the eyes, using as a morning cleanser.
reviews.zh: 好容易起泡，隻手濕少少就已經搓到好多泡。味道好聞唔會太搶。洗完皮膚乾淨但唔會繃緊。就算用喺眼周都唔刺激，我用佢做早上嘅潔面。

reviews.shade: Anua Peach Niacin Spread Cleansing Foam 150ml
reviews.text: Anua peach cleansing foam is amazing and feels so soft on the skin. it cleans my face thoroughly while still keeping my skin moisturized and comfortable. after washing, my skin looks brighter, smoother, and healthier. the peach scent is very приятный and makes the whole experience feel luxurious. i truly enjoy using this cleanser every day.
reviews.zh: Anua 桃子潔面泡沫超讚，搽上面好柔軟。徹底洗乾淨塊面之餘，皮膚仲 keep 住保濕又舒服。洗完好似皮膚光澤咗、滑咗、健康咗。桃子香味非常怡人，成個體驗都好奢華。每日用都真係好享受。

reviews.shade: Anua Peach Niacin Spread Cleansing Foam 150ml
reviews.text: I love how it lathers with lots of bubble. It has a nice smooth texture of peach bits that give la the skin a very mild exfoliation. Gentle on the skin.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意佢搓到好多泡。內含細滑嘅桃肉粒子，俾皮膚好溫和嘅去角質。對皮膚好溫和。

reviews.shade: Anua Peach Niacin Spread Cleansing Foam 150ml
reviews.text: Use it every morning my skin feels very clean. Did not cause me any issues. I do love the whole peach collection
reviews.zh: 每日朝早都用，皮膚覺得好乾淨。冇引起任何問題。成個桃子系列我都好鍾意。

reviews.shade: Anua Peach Niacin Spread Cleansing Foam 150ml
reviews.text: Anua Peach Niacin Spread Cleansing Foam — мягкая и комфортная пенка для умывания. Хорошо очищает кожу от загрязнений и остатков макияжа, не пересушивая и не вызывая стянутости. Пенка легко взбивается, имеет нежный аромат персика. Благодаря ниацинамиду кожа после умывания выглядит более свежей и ровной. Подходит для ежедневного использования, в том числе для чувствительной кожи.
reviews.zh: Anua Peach Niacin Spread Cleansing Foam — 柔軟舒適嘅洗面奶。能夠徹底清除皮膚上嘅污垢同殘留彩妝，唔會令皮膚乾燥或繃緊。泡沫容易起，有淡淡嘅桃香。多得菸鹼醯胺，洗完嘅皮膚睇落更清新、更均勻。適合每日使用，包括敏感肌。

reviews.shade: Anua Peach Niacin Spread Cleansing Foam 150ml
reviews.text: Product is good but FedEx delivery was a disaster. Whole box was damaged. It is good I didn't order any fragile items together
reviews.zh: 產品本身唔錯，但 FedEx 速遞真係災難。成個箱都爛晒。慶幸冇同其他易碎品一齊訂。

reviews.shade: Anua Peach Niacin Spread Cleansing Foam 150ml
reviews.text: Anua peach niacin cleansing foam it is perfect ,, it cleanse skin perfect ,, it suitable for oily skin …
reviews.zh: Anua peach niacin cleansing foam 完全 perfect，，清潔皮膚 perfect，，適合油性肌…

reviews.shade: Anua Peach Niacin Spread Cleansing Foam 150ml
reviews.text: I got this because I loveeee peach, and I was super excited to use it. I don’t think it does anything extremely different or special to my skin but the packaging is cute
reviews.zh: 買呢個係因為我超超超鍾意桃，好期待用。但覺得對皮膚冇話特別唔同或出色，不過包裝得意。
